title: Demodulating Soviet-French Venus balloon probe signal for JPL
place_text: Venus; Institute for Defense Analysis; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: the Russians and the French sent a probe to Hal's Comet the Probe on its way did a gravitational assist fly by a Venus while it was near Venus it dropped two balloon probes into the atmosphere of Venus

plain: In the mid-1980s, a Soviet and French probe heading for Halley's Comet swung past Venus and dropped two balloon probes into its atmosphere, and Bob Maguire, a former contractor for the CIA, says he helped decode their radio signal for NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Maguire says he did this work himself at the Institute for Defense Analysis, a research group that works for the Pentagon, and tells it to show the kind of technical work he did.
